correctness.rationale: Translation reduces to a support containing zero and the transform factors through the restriction to H=<S-S>, so every local Fourier value repeats on a coset of H^perp. In affine dimension one, Tao's prime-cyclic theorem gives at most two zeros for the three-term local transform, and the submitted coefficient triples realize exactly 0, 1 and 2 zeros. In affine dimension two, a zero forces the p-th root zeta^x to lie on a nondegenerate real line intersecting the unit circle in at most two points, and each x determines y uniquely; the three explicit coefficient triples again realize 0, 1 and 2 zeros. Multiplication by |H^perp| gives the stated sizes. The inspected exact-cyclotomic verifier checks representative primes and witnesses but is only corroborative; the proof supplies the universal quantifiers.

final_claim: For every odd prime p and d>=2, a function on F_p^d with exactly three nonzero coefficients has a Fourier-support size determined by the affine dimension of its support and a local zero count j in {0,1,2}: (p-j)p^{d-1} in affine dimension one and (p^2-j)p^{d-2} in affine dimension two; every j occurs on every fixed support, so the global spectrum is exactly the five stated values.
